test_name: Verify Admin Role Assignment and Removal Workflow
description: Ensures that an admin can successfully assign and remove user roles such as 'Admin' and verify updates to the system.
steps: Navigate to the Admin tab using the link with the text 'Admin'.
Locate the user named 'bhhavya.sureka' in the user table.
Click the 'Remove Admin' button next to the user 'bhhavya.sureka'.
Verify a confirmation prompt appears and click the 'Confirm' button.
Locate the same user 'bhhavya.sureka' and click the 'Make Admin' button.
Verify that the user's role is updated to 'Admin' in the user table.
expected_results: User 'bhhavya.sureka' is successfully removed as an admin.
User 'bhhavya.sureka' is successfully re-assigned as an admin.
edge_cases: User table fails to load due to network issues.
Confirmation prompt does not appear after clicking 'Remove Admin'.
Role assignment fails due to backend API issues.
User role remains unchanged despite action confirmation.
Role assignment button becomes non-functional due to UI bugs.
data_requirements: Pre-existing user 'bhhavya.sureka' with an admin role.
Role assignment buttons available in the user table.
Backend API for user role updates.
dependencies: Admin privileges to access the role management page.
User table correctly populated with user data.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch user roles.
POST request to update user roles.
GET request to verify role changes.
performance_metrics: Time taken to update user role via API.
Time taken for confirmation prompts to appear.
Page load time for the Admin dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all role assignment buttons are accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify ARIA roles and labels for confirmation prompts.
Check color contrast for role change buttons.
